# terms.Response { #formulae.terms.Response }

```python
terms.Response(term)
```

Model response term.

It is mostly a wrapper around [Term](`formulae.terms.Term`).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**term**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Term](`formulae.terms.terms.Term`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The term we want to take as response in the model. Must contain only one component.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [var_names](#formulae.terms.Response.var_names) | Returns the name of the variables in the response as a set. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [set_data](#formulae.terms.Response.set_data) | Set data of the response term. |
| [set_type](#formulae.terms.Response.set_type) | Set type of the response term. |

### set_data { #formulae.terms.Response.set_data }

```python
terms.Response.set_data()
```

Set data of the response term.

### set_type { #formulae.terms.Response.set_type }

```python
terms.Response.set_type(data, env)
```

Set type of the response term.
